title: Room Tier Used to Price Bed-Hold Nights in Resident Funds Overcharge Returns
content:
In the return of a bed-hold overcharge paid from a Resident Trust Fund Accounts account, each night due is priced at the private daily rate for **the room tier priced**. The room tier priced follows the hold, as the reservation under Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations and the resident's Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency agreement record it:

| Records | Room tier priced |
|---|---|
| the reservation records the room tier held | that tier, because a held bed is priced at the tier of the room held |
| the reservation records none, and the agreement records an isolation placement the center directed | the agreement's isolation billing tier |
| otherwise | the room tier of the resident's private-pay agreement |

## Hypothetical illustration

| Room tier held on the reservation | Agreement tier | Center-directed isolation placement | Tier priced |
|---|---|---|---|
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | Private Long-Term Care Room | no | Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room |
| none | Private Long-Term Care Room | yes | the agreement's isolation billing tier |
| none | Private Bariatric Care Room | no | Private Bariatric Care Room |
